title: Personal Loans Agreement Terms: Offer Period, Funding Time and Interest Basis
content:
These terms apply to every Larkspur Personal Loans grade and fix how long an approved offer stays open, how soon a signed loan is funded, how simple interest is counted and how each payment is applied.

## Terms by grade

| | Grade A | Grade B | Grade C | Grade D | Grade E | Grade F | Grade G |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Offer open for signing, calendar days from approval | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Funding after signing, business days | 1 | 1 | 1 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Interest day count | actual/365 | actual/365 | actual/365 | actual/365 | actual/365 | actual/365 | actual/365 |

Payment allocation order, every grade: accrued interest, then unpaid fees, then principal.

Treatment of any amount paid beyond what is due, every grade: applied to principal; does not advance the next due date.

## Definitions

- **Offer open for signing**: calendar days an approved offer stays open for signing, counted from the approval date.
- **Funding after signing**: business days after signing until funds are disbursed.
- **Interest day count**: simple-interest day count: actual days elapsed over a 365-day year (no leap-day adjustment).
- **Payment allocation order**: order in which every payment is applied.
- **Excess payment treatment**: treatment of any amount paid beyond what is due.

## Worked reading (hypothetical figures)

Under actual/365, one day of interest on a hypothetical unpaid principal of 10000.00 USD at 10.00 percent is 10000.00 times 10.00 percent divided by 365, about 2.74 USD; thirty days come to about 82.19 USD. A leap year still divides by 365.

A hypothetical payment of 500.00 USD meeting 40.00 USD of accrued interest and 15.00 USD of unpaid fees applies 40.00 to interest, then 15.00 to fees, then the remaining 445.00 to principal.
